desc.Seal of Righteousness: Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 20.5 to 71.4 Holy damage. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 162 Holy damage to an enemy.
desc.Purify: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.
desc.Lay on Hands: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health and restores 550 of their mana. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining Mana when used, but does not interrupt Mana regeneration.
desc.Blessing of Wisdom: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 40 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Consecration: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 96 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 216 damage over 8 sec.
desc.Exorcism: Causes 474.7 Holy damage to an Undead or Demon target.
desc.Seal of Light: Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 94. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting melee attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 61. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
desc.Seal of Wisdom: Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 90 of the Paladin's mana. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting attacks and spells used against the judged enemy a chance to restore 59 mana to the attacker. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
desc.Blessing of Light: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing the effects of Holy Light spells used on the target by up to 400 and the effect Flash of Light spells used on the target by up to 115. Lasts 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Cleanse: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 magic effect.
desc.Hammer of Wrath: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 473.6 Holy damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.
desc.Holy Shock: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 334.3 Holy damage to an enemy, or 307.4 healing to an ally.
desc.Holy Wrath: Sends bolts of holy power in all directions, causing 490 Holy damage to all Undead and Demon targets within ... yds and stunning them for 2 sec.
desc.Light's Vigil: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes allied targets to heal their party for 684.2, or enemy targets to suffer 380.1 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost. You may only have 1 Light's Vigil active per Paladin, per party.
desc.Greater Blessing of Wisdom: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Wisdom, restoring 40 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Greater Blessing of Light: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Light, increasing the effects of Holy Light spells used on the target by up to 400 and the effect Flash of Light spells used on the target by up to 115. Lasts 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Enhanced Blessings: Increases the duration of your Blessing of Might, Wisdom, Salvation, Sanctuary, Light, and Kings by 100% and reduces their mana cost by 50%.
desc.Redemption: Brings a dead player back to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.
desc.Sense Undead: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.
desc.Turn Undead: The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one target can be turned at a time.
desc.Devotion Aura: Gives 55 additional armor to party members within 30 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Divine Protection: You are protected from all physical attacks and spells for 8 sec, but during that time you cannot attack or use physical abilities yourself. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
desc.Blessing of Protection: A targeted party member is protected from all physical attacks for 10 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
desc.Seal of Fury: Fills the Paladin with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 35 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy causes 146.3 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 4 sec.
desc.Righteous Fury: Increases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 90%. Lasts 30 min.
desc.Blessing of Freedom: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 10 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Blessing of Kings: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Concentration Aura: Gives a 35% chance of ignoring spell interruption when damaged to all party members within 30 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Seal of Justice: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, preventing them from fleeing. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
desc.Blessing of Salvation: Places a Blessing on the party member, reducing the amount of all threat generated by 30% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Shadow Resistance Aura: Gives 30 additional Shadow resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Divine Intervention: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way. Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but cannot take any action for 3 min.
desc.Frost Resistance Aura: Gives 30 additional Frost resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Divine Shield: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 12 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
desc.Fire Resistance Aura: Gives 30 additional Fire resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Hammer of the Righteous: Hammer the current target and up to 3 additional nearby targets, causing Holy damage to each equal to 3 times the damage per second of your main hand weapon. Cooldown shared with Crusader Strike.
desc.Blessing of Sacrifice: Places a Blessing on the party member, transfering 55 damage taken per hit to the caster. Lasts 30 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Holy Shield: Increases chance to block by 20% for 10 sec, and deals 221 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat.
desc.Greater Blessing of Kings: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Kings, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Greater Blessing of Salvation: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Salvation, reducing the amount of all threat generated by 30% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Blessing of Might: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 133 for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Judgement: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect.
desc.Holy Strike: An instant strike that causes 40% weapon damage plus an additional 81.4 as Holy damage.
desc.Seal of the Crusader: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 306 melee attack power. The Paladin also attacks 40% faster, but deals less damage with each attack. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 161. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
desc.Retribution Aura: Causes 7 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Seal of Command: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 169.5 Holy damage, 339 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.
desc.Greater Blessing of Might: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Might, increasing melee attack power by 133 for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Exorcist: Exorcism can now be cast on any target and has 100% increased critical strike chance against Undead and Demons.

Blessing of Wisdom.ct: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 20 mana every 5 seconds for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
Blessing of Wisdom.note: Classic R3 restores 20 mana per 5 sec for 5 min; Forever 24 mana for 1 hour

Consecration.ct: Consecrates the land beneath Paladin, doing 120 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area.
Consecration.note: Classic Holy talent doing flat 120 damage over 8 sec; Forever 24 plus 56 extra to first 4 enemies

Exorcism.ct: Causes 221 to 249 Holy damage to an Undead or Demon target.
Exorcism.note: Forever R3 deals 194-218; Classic R3 at level 38 deals 221-249

Flash of Light.ct: Heals a friendly target for 151 to 170.
Flash of Light.note: Forever R3 heals 101-114; Classic R3 at level 38 heals 151-170 (Classic R2 is 102-117)

Holy Light.ct: Heals a friendly target for 698 to 780.
Holy Light.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Same rank; Forever R6 heals 717-799 at 38, Classic R6 heals 698-780 at 38 (717-799 only at its level-43 cap)

Lay on Hands.ct: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health and restores 250 of their mana. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining mana when used.
Lay on Hands.note: Forever adds that draining mana does not interrupt mana regeneration; Classic simply drains all mana

Purify.ct: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.

Redemption.ct: Brings a dead player back to life with 250 health and 420 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

Seal of Light.ct: Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 39. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, granting melee attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 25. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
Seal of Light.note: Judgement lasts 40 sec in Forever, 10 sec in Classic

Seal of Righteousness.ct: Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 11 to 37 Holy damage. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 90 to 99 Holy damage to an enemy.
Seal of Righteousness.note: Matches Classic R5 at level 38, except melee minimum 10 vs 11 (rounding)

Seal of Wisdom.ct: Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 50 of the Paladin's mana. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, granting attacks and spells used against the judged enemy a chance to restore 33 mana to the attacker. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
Seal of Wisdom.note: Judgement lasts 40 sec in Forever, 10 sec in Classic

Sense Undead.ct: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.
Sense Undead.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. No difference

Turn Undead.ct: The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 15 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one target can be turned at a time.
Turn Undead.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. No difference

Blessing of Freedom.ct: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 10 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Blessing of Kings.ct: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
Blessing of Kings.note: Classic Protection talent lasting 5 min; Forever lasts 1 hour

Blessing of Protection.ct: A targeted party member is protected from all physical attacks for 10 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. Once protected, the target cannot be made invulnerable by Divine Shield, Divine Protection or Blessing of Protection again for 1 min.
Blessing of Protection.note: Wording only: Forever names the Forbearance debuff that Classic describes

Blessing of Salvation.ct: Places a Blessing on the party member, reducing the amount of all threat generated by 30% for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
Blessing of Salvation.note: Lasts 1 hour in Forever, 5 min in Classic

Concentration Aura.ct: Gives a 35% chance of ignoring spell interruption when damaged to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Devotion Aura.ct: Gives 390 additional armor to party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Divine Intervention.ct: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way. Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but cannot take any action for 3 min.
Divine Intervention.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. No difference

Divine Protection.ct: You are protected from all physical attacks and spells for 8 sec, but during that time you cannot attack or use physical abilities yourself. Once protected, the target cannot be made invulnerable by Divine Shield, Divine Protection or Blessing of Protection again for 1 min.
Divine Protection.note: Wording only: Forever names the Forbearance debuff that Classic describes

Divine Shield.ct: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but increases the time between your attacks by 100%. Once protected, the target cannot be made invulnerable by Divine Shield, Divine Protection or Blessing of Protection again for 1 min.
Divine Shield.note: Classic Era penalty: 100% slower attacks; Forever: 50% less damage dealt

Fire Resistance Aura.ct: Gives 30 additional Fire resistance to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Frost Resistance Aura.ct: Gives 30 additional Frost resistance to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Hammer of Justice.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. No difference; Classic Rank 3 arrives at 40

Righteous Fury.ct: Increases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 60%. Lasts 30 min.
Righteous Fury.note: Holy threat bonus is 90% in Forever, 60% in Classic

Seal of Fury.note: Forever-only tank seal: shield absorb and taunting Judgement; Classic has only unused, textless Seal of Fury data

Seal of Justice.ct: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
Seal of Justice.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. No difference

Shadow Resistance Aura.ct: Gives 30 additional Shadow resistance to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Blessing of Might.ct: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 85 for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Holy Strike.note: Forever-only weapon strike; Classic Holy Strike exists only as an NPC ability

Judgement.ct: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect.
Judgement.note: Forever Judgement no longer consumes the Seal and can taunt via Seal of Fury

Retribution Aura.ct: Causes 12 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
Retribution Aura.note: Forever R3 deals 18 Holy damage per hit; Classic R3 deals 12

Seal of Command.ct: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 169 to 186 Holy damage, 339 to 373 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.
Seal of Command.note: Classic talent, Rank 2 at 38; Forever Rank 5, 76% weapon damage vs 70%, bigger Judgement

Seal of the Crusader.ct: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 157 melee attack power. The Paladin also attacks 40% faster, but deals less damage with each attack. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 80. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
Seal of the Crusader.note: Judgement lasts 40 sec for up to 92 Holy in Forever; Classic 10 sec, up to 80

desc.Aspect of the Monkey: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
desc.Aspect of the Hawk: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 120. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
desc.Revive Pet: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.
desc.Mend Pet: Heals your pet 245 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.
desc.Eyes of the Beast: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 2 min.
desc.Aspect of the Cheetah: The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%. If the hunter takes damage, he will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
desc.Summon Hawk: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing ... Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
desc.Aspect of the Pack: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%.  If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec.  Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
desc.Aspect of the Wild: The hunter and all party and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 45.  Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
desc.Improved Mend Pet: No tooltip text in the beta client yet.
desc.Tranquilizing Shot: Attempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.
desc.Aspect of the Beast: The hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 110. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
desc.Aspect of the Falcon: The hunter takes on the aspects of a Falcon, increasing melee and ranged Attack Power by the same amount as their highest rank of Aspect of the Hawk. While Aspect of the Falcon is active, the Improved Aspect of the Hawk talent can now proc from and benefit melee attacks. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
desc.Aspect of the Viper: The hunter takes on the aspect of the viper, causing your ranged and melee auto attacks to regenerate mana but reducing your total damage done by 10%. In addition, you gain 10% of maximum mana every 3 sec. Mana gained is based on the speed of your weapon. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
desc.Beast Lore: Gather information about the target beast. The tooltip will display damage, health, armor, any special resistances, and diet.
desc.Dismiss Pet: Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.
desc.Eagle Eye: Zooms in the hunter's vision. Only usable outdoors. Lasts 1 min.
desc.Feed Pet: Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.
desc.Scare Beast: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.
desc.Tame Beast: Begins taming a beast to be your companion.  Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec.  If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail.  Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal.  Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.
desc.Auto Shot: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.
desc.Serpent Sting: Stings the target, causing 555 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.
desc.Arcane Shot: An instant shot that causes 217 Arcane damage.
desc.Hunter's Mark: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 71. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 2 min.
desc.Concussive Shot: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.
desc.Distracting Shot: Distract the target, causing threat. More effective than Distracting Shot (Rank 5).
desc.Multi-Shot: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets. Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot.
desc.Aimed Shot: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 166. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.
desc.Scorpid Sting: Stings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.
desc.Rapid Fire: Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.
desc.Flare: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.
desc.Trueshot Aura: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yards by 40. Lasts 30 min.
desc.Viper Sting: Stings the target, draining 1108 mana over 8 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.
desc.Volley: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 70 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec.
desc.Sniper Shot: A steady snipe that increases ranged damage by 295.
desc.Black Arrow: Fires a Black Arrow into the target, slowing the target's movement speed by 70%, causing 150 Shadow damage and draining 150 mana over 30 sec.
desc.Enchanted Flare: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area, and staves off magical darkness for 30 sec.
desc.Raptor Strike: A strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 70.
desc.Track Beasts: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
desc.Track Humanoids: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
desc.Wing Clip: Inflicts 50 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 60% for 10 sec.
desc.Immolation Trap: Place a Fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 690 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.
desc.Mongoose Bite: Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 57. Can only be performed after you dodge.
desc.Track Undead: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
desc.Disengage: Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. More effective than Disengage (Rank 2). Disables auto-attack.
desc.Freezing Trap: Place a Frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 20 sec. Any damage caused will break the ice. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.
desc.Track Hidden: Increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
desc.Track Elementals: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
desc.Frost Trap: Place a Frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.
desc.Counterattack: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 110 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.
desc.Feign Death: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 6 min. If not cancelled, after 6 min you will actually die.
desc.Lacerate: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 406 damage over 21 sec.
desc.Track Demons: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
desc.Explosive Trap: Place a Fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 201 Fire damage and 330 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within ... yards. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.
desc.Track Giants: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
desc.Track Dragonkin: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
desc.Heart of the Lion: The hunter invokes the heart of a lion, increasing total stats by 10% and Attack Power by 40 for all nearby allies, and increasing total stats for the Hunter by an additional 10%.
desc.Cower: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat, making the enemy less likely to attack you.
desc.Growl: Taunt the target, increasing the likelihood the creature will focus attacks on you.
desc.Charge: Charges an enemy, immobilizes it for 1 sec, and adds 490 melee attack power to the boar's next attack.
desc.Dash: Increases movement speed by 80% for 15 sec.
desc.Demoralizing Screech: Blasts a single enemy for 23.8 damage and lowers the melee attack power of all enemies in melee range by 198 for 30 sec.
desc.Dismember: Viciously bites enemy appendages for 50.2 damage and reduces the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.
desc.Dive: Increases movement speed by 80% for 15 sec.
desc.Dust Cloud: Your tallstrider kicks up an abrasive cloud of dust, reducing the target's Armor by 505 for 30 sec.
desc.Furious Howl: The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 15 yards by 136.  Lasts 1 min.
desc.Lava Breath: Breathes molten lava at 2 nearby enemies, instantly dealing 99 Fire damage and reducing the target's casting speed by 25% for 10 sec.
desc.Lightning Breath: Breathes lightning, instantly dealing 85.9 Nature damage to a single target.
desc.Mine!: Grabs an enemy's weapon with its talons, causing 40.9 damage and disarming them for 4 sec.
desc.Pinch: Pinches an enemy's legs for 88.4 damage and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.
desc.Prowl: Puts your pet in stealth mode, but slows its movement speed by 40%. The first attack from stealth receives a 50% bonus to damage.  Lasts until cancelled.
desc.Savage Rend: Slash an enemy with razor talons, causing the target to Bleed for 156 damage over 18 sec.
desc.Scorpid Poison: Inflicts 25 Nature damage over 10 sec. Effect can stack up to 5 times on a single target.
desc.Shell Shield: Reduces all damage your pet takes by 50% and increases the time between your pet's attacks by 60%, but deals more damage with each attack. Lasts 12 sec.
desc.Tendon Rip: Tears at an enemy's legs for 60 damage over 9 sec and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.
desc.Thunderstomp: Shakes the ground with thundering force, doing 122.4 Nature damage to all enemies within $a1 yards.
desc.Trickster's Dance: Increases your pet's chance to Dodge by 50% and decreases the time between your pet's attacks by 30%. Lasts 12 sec.
desc.Web: Entangles an enemy in a corrosive web, immobilizing them and dealing 52 Nature damage over 4 sec.

desc.Sinister Strike: An instant strike that causes 68 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point.
desc.Backstab: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 150 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.
desc.Gouge: Causes 75 damage, stops your attack, and incapacitates the target for 4 sec. The target must be facing you. Any damage taken will break the effect. Awards 1 combo point.
desc.Evasion: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.
desc.Sprint: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 70% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth.
desc.Kick: A quick kick that injures a single foe for 80 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
desc.Feint: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.
desc.Stealth: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.
desc.Sap: Incapacitates the target for up to 45 sec. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage taken will break the effect. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time. Does not break Stealth.
desc.Distract: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby enemies and reducing their Stealth detection as if they were 1 level lower for 10 seconds. Does not break stealth.
desc.Vanish: Allows the rogue to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec. Also breaks movement impairing effects. More effective than Vanish (Rank 1).
desc.Disarm Trap: Sneak up on the trap in order to disarm it. Don't get too close or the trap will go off.
desc.Blind: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect.
desc.Detect Traps: Greatly increased chance to detect traps.
desc.Redirect: Removes all your existing combo points from your target and stores them for up to 15 sec. These stored combat points will be transferred to the next non-player enemy you hit with a melee or ranged ability.
desc.Eviscerate: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point, increased by Attack Power: 1 point : ... damage 2 points: ... damage 3 points: ... damage 4 points: ... damage 5 points: ... damage
desc.Slice and Dice:
Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 20%.  Lasts longer per combo point:
   1 point  : 9 seconds
   2 points: 12 seconds
   3 points: 15 seconds
   4 points: 18 seconds
   5 points: 21 seconds
desc.Expose Armor: Finishing move that exposes the target for 30 sec, reducing armor per combo point: 1 point : 450 armor 2 points: 900 armor 3 points: 1350 armor 4 points: 1800 armor 5 points: 2250 armor
desc.Garrote: Garrote the enemy, causing 552 damage over 18 sec, increased by your Attack Power. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.
desc.Ambush: Ambush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 290 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.
desc.Rupture: Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your Attack Power. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 158.9 damage over 8 secs 2 points: 222.3 damage over 10 secs 3 points: 295.1 damage over 12 secs 4 points: 377.4 damage over 14 secs 5 points: 469.2 damage over 16 secs
desc.Cheap Shot: Stuns the target for 4 sec. Must be stealthed. Awards 2 combo points.
desc.Kidney Shot: Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 2 seconds 2 points: 3 seconds 3 points: 4 seconds 4 points: 5 seconds 5 points: 6 seconds

desc.Stoneskin Totem: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster.  The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing Physical damage taken by 4.  Lasts 5 min.
desc.Lightning Shield: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 178 Nature damage.
desc.Strength of Earth Totem: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster.  The totem increases the strength of party members within 30 yards by 7.  Lasts 5 min.
desc.Ghost Wolf: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.
desc.Totemic Projection: Relocates your active totems to the specified location.
desc.Frost Resistance Totem: Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min.  The totem increases party and raid members' frost resistance by 30, if within 30 yards.
desc.Fire Resistance Totem: Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the fire resistance of party and raid members within 30 yards by 30.
desc.Flametongue Totem: Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enchants all party members' main-hand weapons with fire if they are within 30 yards. Each hit causes 6.1 to 21.9 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts 5 min.
desc.Grounding Totem: Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 seconds. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.
desc.Nature Resistance Totem: Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the nature resistance of party and raid members within 30 yards by 30.
desc.Windfury Weapon: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 333 extra melee attack power. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Windfury Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.
desc.Windfury Totem: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party members within ... yards. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with ... extra melee attack power. Lasts 5 min.
desc.Sentry Totem: Summons an immobile Sentry Totem with 100 health at your feet for 5 min that allows vision of nearby area and warns of enemies that attack it. Right-Click on buff to switch back and forth between totem sight and shaman sight.
desc.Windwall Totem: Summons a Windwall Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster.  The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing ranged damage taken by 32.  Lasts 5 min.
desc.Grace of Air Totem: Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster.  The totem increases the agility of party members within 30 yards by 49.  Lasts 5 min.
desc.Astral Recall: Yanks the caster through the twisting nether back to ... Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.
desc.Far Sight: Changes the caster's viewpoint to the targeted location. Lasts 1 min. Only useable outdoors.
desc.Flametongue Weapon: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 31.4 to 99.9 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Flametongue Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.
desc.Frostbrand Weapon: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with frost. Each hit has a chance of causing 158 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 25% for 8 sec. Lasts for 60 minutes.
desc.Rockbiter Weapon: Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 554 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes.
desc.Water Breathing: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.
desc.Water Walking: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.
desc.Lightning Bolt: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 185.4 Nature damage.
desc.Earth Shock: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 293.1 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.
desc.Earthbind Totem: Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within ... yards.
desc.Stoneclaw Totem: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 480 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within ... yards to attack it.
desc.Flame Shock: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 166 Fire damage immediately and 176 Fire damage over 12 sec.
desc.Searing Totem: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 55 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 40 Fire damage.
desc.Fire Nova: Instantly inflicts 396 fire damage to enemies within ... yd of your active Fire totem.
desc.Purge: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial magic effects.
desc.Call of the Elements: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.
desc.Frost Shock: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 275.1 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.
desc.Totemic Recall: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.
desc.Magma Totem: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 73 Fire damage to creatures within ... yards every 2 seconds.
desc.Call of the Ancestors: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.
desc.Chain Lightning: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 116.2 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.
desc.Call of the Spirits: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.
desc.Lava Burst: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 192.1 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.
desc.Ancestral Spirit: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.
desc.Cure Poison: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.
desc.Tremor Totem: Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within ... yards. Lasts 5 min.
desc.Healing Stream Totem: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 5 every 2 seconds.
desc.Poison Cleansing Totem: Summons a Poison Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 poison effect from party members within ... yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.
desc.Mana Spring Totem: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 4 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 30 yards.
desc.Reincarnation: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.
desc.Disease Cleansing Totem: Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within ... yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 2 min.
desc.Chain Heal: Heals the friendly target for 457.6, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets.
desc.Mana Tide Totem: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 197 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.
desc.Riptide: Heals a friendly target for 798.9, an additional 805 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

Chain Lightning.ct: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 200 to 227 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.
Chain Lightning.note: Same rank; Forever 64-71 damage, Classic Rank 1 200-227.

Earth Shock.ct: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 235 to 249 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.
Earth Shock.note: Same rank; Forever 162-171 damage, Classic Rank 5 235-249 (229-243 at level 38).

Earthbind Totem.ct: Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.
Earthbind Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Fire Nova.ct: Summons a Fire Nova Totem that has 5 health and lasts 5 sec. Unless it is destroyed within 4 sec., the totem inflicts 195 to 219 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd.
Fire Nova.note: Was Fire Nova Totem (explodes after 4 sec); Forever instant nova around active Fire totem, same damage. Forever text is the Season of Discovery Fire Nova Rank 3 tooltip (spell 408343) used as a stand-in, not read off the demo.

Flame Shock.ct: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 95 Fire damage immediately and 96 Fire damage over 12 sec.
Flame Shock.note: Same rank; Forever 66 + 89 over 12 sec, Classic Rank 3 95 + 96.

Frost Shock.ct: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 215 to 230 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.
Frost Shock.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical to Wowhead default text; Classic scales to 213-228 at level 38.

Lightning Bolt.ct: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 235 to 264 Nature damage.
Lightning Bolt.note: Same rank; Forever 102-113 damage, Classic Rank 7 235-264 (227-255 at level 38).

Magma Totem.ct: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 37 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.

Purge.ct: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial magic effects.
Purge.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Searing Totem.ct: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 40 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 19 to 25 Fire damage.
Searing Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Stoneclaw Totem.ct: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 280 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it.
Stoneclaw Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Totemic Recall.note: No Classic Era counterpart; Classic totems cannot be recalled.

Astral Recall.ct: Yanks the caster through the twisting nether back to Hearthstone Location. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.
Astral Recall.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Far Sight.ct: Changes the caster's viewpoint to the targeted location. Lasts 1 min. Only useable outdoors.

Fire Resistance Totem.ct: Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 2 min that increases the fire resistance of party members within 20 yards by 30.
Fire Resistance Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Flametongue Totem.ct: Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enchants all party members' main-hand weapons with fire if they are within 20 yards. Each hit causes (697 / 77 * 1) to (697 / 25 * 1) additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts 2 min.
Flametongue Totem.note: Forever 30 yd, 9 to 31 Fire damage per main-hand hit, lasts 5 min; Classic 20 yd, (697 / 77) to (697 / 25) Fire damage (about 9 to 28), lasts 2 min.

Flametongue Weapon.ct: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 22 to 69 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts for 5 minutes.
Flametongue Weapon.note: Identical to Wowhead default text; Classic scales to 16-51 at level 38.

Frost Resistance Totem.ct: Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 2 min. The totem increases party members' frost resistance by 45, if within 20 yards.
Frost Resistance Totem.note: Forever 5 min, 30 yd, party and raid; Classic 2 min, 20 yd, party only.

Frostbrand Weapon.ct: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with frost. Each hit has a chance of causing 48 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 25% for 8 sec. Lasts for 5 minutes.
Frostbrand Weapon.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Forever book shows it unranked; its text (48 dmg) is Classic Rank 1's tooltip (spell 8033, a talentsforever Wowhead fallback, not read off the demo). Classic trains Rank 3 by 38 (124; 84 at level 38).

Ghost Wolf.ct: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.

Grounding Totem.ct: Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 seconds. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.
Grounding Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Lightning Shield.ct: The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 80 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.
Lightning Shield.note: Same rank; Forever 86 damage per ball, Classic Rank 4 80. Forever text drops Classic's "This expends one lightning ball."

Nature Resistance Totem.ct: Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 2 min that increases the nature resistance of party members within 20 yards by 30.
Nature Resistance Totem.note: Forever 5 min, 30 yd, party and raid; Classic 2 min, 20 yd, party only.

Rockbiter Weapon.ct: Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 355 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 5 minutes.
Rockbiter Weapon.note: Forever lasts 60 min, Classic 5 min; 283 AP matches Classic Rank 5 at level 38.

Sentry Totem.ct: Summons an immobile Sentry Totem with 100 health at your feet for 5 min that allows vision of nearby area and warns of enemies that attack it. Right-Click on buff to switch back and forth between totem sight and shaman sight.
Sentry Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Stoneskin Totem.ct: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 20 yards, reducing melee damage taken by 16. Lasts 2 min.
Stoneskin Totem.note: Forever 30 yd, Physical damage, 5 min; Classic 20 yd, melee damage, 2 min.

Strength of Earth Totem.ct: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party members within 20 yards by 36. Lasts 2 min.
Strength of Earth Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Totemic Projection.note: Not in Classic Era; Wowhead Classic lists it only for Season of Discovery (Phase 2).

Water Breathing.ct: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.
Water Breathing.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Water Walking.ct: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.

Windfury Totem.ct: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enchants all party members main-hand weapons with wind, if they are within 20 yards. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with (122 * 1) extra melee attack power. Lasts 2 min.
Windfury Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Windfury Weapon.ct: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 104 extra melee attack power. Lasts for 5 minutes.

Windwall Totem.ct: Summons a Windwall Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 20 yards, reducing ranged damage taken by 32. Lasts 2 min.
Windwall Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Ancestral Spirit.ct: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 250 health and 420 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.
Ancestral Spirit.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Cure Poison.ct: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.
Cure Poison.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Disease Cleansing Totem.ct: Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 20 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 2 min.
Disease Cleansing Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Identical tooltip.

Healing Stream Totem.ct: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 1 min that heals group members within 20 yards for 8 every 2 seconds.
Healing Stream Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Same rank (2) as Classic at 38; no Forever tooltip to compare.

Healing Wave.ct: Heals a friendly target for 552 to 639.
Healing Wave.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Same rank (6) as Classic at 38; no Forever tooltip to compare.

Lesser Healing Wave.ct: Heals a friendly target for 349 to 394.
Lesser Healing Wave.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Same rank (3) as Classic at 38; no Forever tooltip to compare.

Mana Spring Totem.ct: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 1 min that restores 6 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 20 yards.
Mana Spring Totem.note: Forever lasts 5 min, 30 yd; Classic 1 min, 20 yd.

Poison Cleansing Totem.ct: Summons a Poison Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 poison effect from party members within 20 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 2 min.
Poison Cleansing Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. No Forever tooltip to compare; unranked in both.

Reincarnation.ct: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.
Reincarnation.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. Passive in both, learned 30 in Classic; no Forever tooltip to compare.

Tremor Totem.ct: Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards. Lasts 2 min.
Tremor Totem.note: The demo tooltip for this one was never captured; the Forever text shown is a Classic placeholder. No Forever tooltip to compare; unranked in both.

Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

desc.Demon Skin: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 120 and increases health regeneration by 5 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.
desc.Summon Imp: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.
desc.Create Healthstone: Creates a Major Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 1440 health. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.
desc.Summon Voidwalker: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.
desc.Health Funnel: Gives 153 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels. Generates reduced threat.
desc.Create Soulstone: Creates a Major Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 2200 health and 2800 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.
desc.Demon Armor: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 570, Shadow resistance by 15 and increases health regeneration by 15 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.
desc.Ritual of Summoning: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.
desc.Summon Incubus: Summons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock.
desc.Summon Succubus: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.
desc.Banish: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 30 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.
desc.Create Firestone: Creates a Major Firestone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Fire, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 2% and the damage done by your Fire spells by up to 21.
desc.Subjugate Demon: Subjugates the target demon, up to level 62, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 5 min. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.
desc.Summon Felhunter: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.
desc.Create Spellstone: Creates a Major Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 2% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 21. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.
desc.Inferno: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 5 min. Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control. Can only be used outdoors.
desc.Portal of Summoning: Begins a ritual that creates a summoning portal. The summoning portal can be used by 2 party or raid members to summon a targeted party or raid member. The ritual portal requires the caster and 2 additional party or raid members to complete. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.
desc.Ritual of Doom: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.
desc.Detect Invisibility: Allows the friendly target to detect greater invisibility for 10 min.
desc.Eye of Kilrogg: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.
desc.Sense Demons: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.
desc.Unending Breath: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.
desc.Corruption: Corrupts the target, causing 438 Shadow damage over 18 sec.
desc.Curse of Weakness: Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 37 for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
desc.Life Tap: Converts 420 health into ... Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount of Mana converted. Mana gained is increased by your Spirit.
desc.Bane of Agony: Afflicts the target with agony, causing 552 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Bane reaches its full duration. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.
desc.Fear: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.
desc.Drain Soul: Drains the soul of the target, causing 420 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.
desc.Curse of Recklessness: Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 505 for 2 min. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
desc.Drain Life: Transfers 51 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.
desc.Curse of the Elements: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Magic resistances by 75 and increases Magic damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
desc.Drain Mana: Transfers 136 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.
desc.Curse of Tongues: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 60%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.
desc.Siphon Life: Transfers 41 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.
desc.Howl of Terror: Howl, causing ... enemies within ... yds to flee in terror for 15 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.
desc.Death Coil: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 454 Shadow damage. The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.
desc.Bane of Doom: Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1742 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.
desc.Immolate: Burns the enemy for 8 Fire damage and then an additional 15 Fire damage over 15 sec.
desc.Shadow Bolt: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 253.3 Shadow damage.
desc.Searing Pain: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 104.8 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.
desc.Rain of Fire: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 880 Fire damage over 8 sec.
desc.Shadowburn: Instantly blasts the target for 251.5 Shadow damage. If the target dies within 8 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.
desc.Hellfire: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 206 Fire damage to himself and 206 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.
desc.Conflagrate: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 251.1 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.
desc.Soul Fire: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 382.6 Fire damage.
desc.Incinerate: Deals 200.7 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
desc.Cower: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat, making the enemy less likely to attack you.
desc.Growl: Taunt the target, increasing the likelihood the creature will focus attacks on you.
desc.Anguish: Taunts the creature, increasing the chance that it will attack the Felguard.
desc.Avoidance: No tooltip text in the beta client yet.
desc.Cleave: A sweeping attack that does the Felguard's weapon damage plus 2 to the target and his nearest ally.
desc.Consume Shadows: The Voidwalker consumes nearby shadows to bolster its form, recovering 1930 health over 10 sec.  Cannot be used while in combat.
desc.Devour Magic: Purges 1 harmful magic effect from a friend or 1 beneficial magic effect from an enemy.  If an effect is devoured, the Felhunter will be healed for 579.
desc.Fire Shield: Surrounds the target in a shield of fire. Every strike against the target causes 13 Fire damage to the attacker. Lasts 3 min.  Your pet cannot cast Fire Shield on itself.
desc.Firebolt: Deals 41.5 Fire damage to a target.
desc.Intercept: Charge an enemy, causing 25 damage and stunning it for 3 sec.
desc.Lash of Pain: An instant attack that lashes the target, causing 50 Shadow damage.
desc.Lesser Invisibility: Gives your summoned demon Lesser Invisibility for up to 5 min.  This spell can only be used out of combat.
desc.Paranoia: Increases the stealth detection of all party members within 30 yds of the Felhunter as if they were 6 levels higher.
desc.Phase Shift: Shifts the imp out of phase with the world, making it unattackable unless it attacks.
desc.Sacrifice: Sacrifices the Voidwalker, giving its owner a shield that will absorb 1905 damage for 30 sec.  While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage.
desc.Seduction: Seduces the target, preventing all actions for up to 15 sec.  Any damage caused will remove the effect.  Only works against Humanoids.
desc.Soothing Kiss: Soothes the target, increasing the chance that it will attack something else.  More effective than Soothing Kiss (Rank 3).
desc.Spell Lock: Silences the enemy for 3 sec.  If used on a casting target, it will counter the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 8 sec.
desc.Suffering: Taunts all enemies within $a1 yards, increasing the chance that they will attack the Voidwalker.  More effective than Suffering (Rank 3).
desc.Tainted Blood: Taints the Felhunter's blood for 1 min.  When the Felhunter is hit with a melee attack, the attacker will lose 40 melee attack power for 10 sec.  Stacks up to 5 times on a single target.
desc.Torment: Taunts the creature, increasing the chance that it will attack the Voidwalker.  More effective than Torment (Rank 5).

desc.Bear Form: Shapeshift into a bear, increasing melee attack power by 30, armor contribution from items by 180%, and health by 180. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
desc.Demoralizing Roar: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 193. Lasts 30 sec.
desc.Growl: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.
desc.Maul: Increases the druid's next attack by 128 damage.
desc.Enrage: Instantly generates 10 Rage and another 20 Rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.
desc.Aquatic Form: Shapeshift into aquatic form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
desc.Cat Form: Shapeshift into cat form, increasing melee attack power by 12 plus Agility. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
desc.Claw: Claw the enemy for 110% normal damage plus 115. Awards 1 combo point.
desc.Prowl: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.
desc.Rip: Finishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power: 1 point : 243 damage over 12 sec. 2 points: 396 damage over 12 sec. 3 points: 549 damage over 12 sec. 4 points: 702 damage over 12 sec. 5 points: 855 damage over 12 sec.
